data.summary: Measured adoption interest for preflight among LLM evaluation practitioners via GitHub issue search and repository analysis. Found multiple independent signals of real demand: 8+ open issues in lm-evaluation-harness about silent metric failures (C1/C2/C3 exactly match), 4+ issues in HELM about judge extraction and silent scoring failures, open proposal in openai/evals for harness-level failure attribution, feature request for reproducibility-bundle export, real audit finding 61/140 tasks with broken scoring in MLS-Bench, and standardization effort evaleval/every_eval_ever (137 stars). Preflight's three checks map directly to these documented problems. Prior art is partially-covered (no tool does all three, C3 is weakest). Created evidence record at EXPERIMENTS/preflight-adoption-interest.md. All preflight tests pass (16+9=25 tests).
